description: Free deterministic check for shot IDs missing from a supplied inventory, unexpected or repeated IDs, and order. If all items have start/end times, also reports gaps and overlaps within the supplied single-track timeline. List delivered items in timeline order. Set inventoryComplete true only if the caller knows the inventory covers the whole edit. This does not inspect video, infer a shot from a prompt, identify an object or decide whether repeats, gaps or transitions are intentional. Review before another render.
name: compare_shot_inventory
title: Compare an approved shot list with a declared edit inventory
